# SENTINEL v0.1.0

SENTINEL v0.1.0 is the first public release of the local-first code review and repository intelligence platform.

## Highlights

- Safe repository registration, bounded discovery, ignore handling, and content fingerprints
- Deterministic analysis for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and TSX using 15 security, quality, reliability, and performance rules
- Evidence-backed findings with source verification and review status
- Repository files, symbols, dependencies, lexical calls, coupling, and cycle exploration
- Optional local Ollama explanations with structured, evidence-cited responses
- Optional local semantic search using callable-entity embeddings
- Reviewed Python patches and pytest proposals with syntax, diff, model-digest, and fingerprint gates
- Docker-only validation and guarded apply and rollback workflows
- SQLite local persistence and PostgreSQL deployment support
- Next.js review interface and FastAPI API
- 117 automated tests plus Ruff, TypeScript, migration, build, API, and browser checks

## Installation

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/Adithiyaaaaaaa/sentinel/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md). The shortest supported Windows production path is:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Adithiyaaaaaaa/sentinel.git
Set-Location sentinel
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install -c requirements-lock.txt -e ".[dev]"
npm ci
Copy-Item .env.example .env
.\scripts\serve.ps1
```

## Optional local models

```shell
ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b
ollama pull embeddinggemma
```

## Important boundaries

- SENTINEL is an engineering review aid, not proof that a repository is secure.
- Findings are bounded by the implemented language and rule coverage.
- AI explanations and patches are unverified opinions or inert proposals until reviewed.
- The current edition is intended for one trusted local user or a controlled private deployment.
- Direct GitHub URL ingestion and public multi-tenant hosting are not implemented.
- Docker validation requires a locally available image pinned by digest.
